metadata.coverage: 5 stories / 15 independent segments; approximately 9-12 seconds per segment; matched historical condition and seed

weight_lineages.pdmd4: unbaked INT8 base -> dequantize -> merge -> requantize
weight_lineages.pdmd8: same weights as pdmd4, 8 NFE extrapolation
weight_lineages.pdmd4bf16: original BF16 base -> BF16 PDMD delta add, BF16/PyTorch attention; some non-DiT parameters retain source dtype
weight_lineages.pdmd4fresh: original BF16 base -> same PDMD merge -> ONE deterministic ConvRot256 rowwise INT8 quantization; nonquantized parameters use current INT8 deployment schema
weight_lineages.larry8: current frozen baked Larry v4 INT8, reproduced sampler; common current INT8 VAE
weight_lineages.r85: frozen actual deployed Larry v4 INT8 media, older optimized INT8 VAE

metadata.protocol: Native-resolution fullframe YUV SSIM/PSNR; LPIPS SqueezeNet v0.1 at 2fps and384x672; 8kHzmono short-window logFFT cosine and32kHzstereo STFT1024/hop256 cosine. t0 alignment, no best shift. References are existing AAC MP4, not raw PCM. No subjective MOS or semantic correctness claim. Fixed test decoder except frozen r85/BF50 media. Sampler time excludes VAE/condition/export; each representative one warmup and one formal run. Other cases quality coverage only, not paired throughput benchmarks.
